parse_pages.title: Parse pages
parse_pages.does: Reads every character of the PDF with its font and position, and renders each page as an image.

text_layer.title: Read the text through its fonts
text_layer.does: Checks how each font maps its codes to letters: a font that stores glyph numbers is decoded, and a page whose text cannot be read is handed to OCR.
text_layer.patch: added by the fork (r6) for fonts embedded without a Unicode map

parser_repair.title: Repair the parser's text
parser_repair.does: Finds words the parser ran together in tightly justified text and puts a space where their glyphs stand apart; letters never change. (On docling-parse 7.20, r8 also replaced letters read as look-alikes by a second reader's, pdfium.)
parser_repair.patch: added by the fork (r8; by the gaps between glyphs since r9), until docling-parse separates these words itself

ocr.title: OCR
ocr.does: Recognises text in the page image where the PDF holds none: bitmap regions, and whole pages whose text cannot be read.
ocr.patch: a page whose text layer is unreadable is read whole

docling_unrecorded.title: Docling conversion
docling_unrecorded.does: Docling converted the PDF with a converter handed to the engine.

layout.title: Layout detection
layout.does: An object-detection model marks the regions of each page: paragraphs, headings, tables, figures, captions, page headers and footers.

layout_cleanup.title: Layout clean-up
layout_cleanup.does: Resolves overlapping regions, gives each the parser's text inside it and drops empty ones.
layout_cleanup.patch: a diagonal watermark is kept out of the text

table_structure.title: Table structure
table_structure.does: Rebuilds the rows, columns and cells of each table region.

assemble.title: Assemble the document
assemble.does: Puts the regions in reading order, joins paragraphs that run on across pages, and builds the document tree.
assemble.patch: a paragraph continued on a page of another size keeps its position

picture_classifier.title: Picture classifier
picture_classifier.does: An image classifier sorts each picture into a kind: chart, photograph, logo, diagram and others.

picture_description.title: Picture description
picture_description.does: A vision-language model writes a short description of each picture.

enrichment.title: Code, formula and chart enrichment
enrichment.does: Optional models that turn code and formulas into text and read the data of charts.

text_repairs.title: Text repairs
text_repairs.does: Removes end-of-text tokens a vision model left in descriptions, rejoins words split at a ligature (fi, fl) where the PDF prints them whole, and keeps the PDF's own text with tables whose cells miss printed words.

structure.title: Structure pass
structure.does: Settles what each element is: running page headers and footers, captions tied to their table or figure, the title, heading levels.

quality.title: Quality report
quality.does: Counts what came out on each page and raises warnings with stable codes, such as no headings or pages without text.

figure_types.title: Figure typing
figure_types.does: Types each figure zero-shot with a biomedical image-text model (BiomedCLIP): CT, ECG, Kaplan-Meier curve, bar chart and others.

noise_filter.title: Picture noise filter
noise_filter.does: Marks logos, badges and pictures repeated on many pages as noise: kept in the HTML, left out of the markdown.

exports.title: Write the bundle
exports.does: Writes the document as Docling JSON, per-element and chunked JSONL, tables and figures as JSONL, markdown, a standalone HTML page and a page viewer.

self_check.title: Self-check
self_check.does: Checks the bundle against the PDF and itself: every item once in the HTML, each page's words in the output, the exports faithful to document.json, table grids, chunks.

figure_to_data.title: Figure to data
figure_to_data.does: A model reads the values plotted in chart figures; values under a confidence threshold are kept out of the markdown.
